title: DirectorLoop Demo Cut
story_arc: Show why raw footage is painful.
Show DirectorLoop turning footage into structured edit artifacts.
Show human approval and a final rendered MP4.

beats.goal: Name the editing pain in one clean sentence.
beats.narration: Hackathon teams record the right moments, then lose time shaping them into a story.

beats.goal: Show the AI pipeline becoming concrete artifacts.
beats.narration: DirectorLoop indexes scenes, drafts a structured plan, and turns each beat into a renderable block.

beats.goal: Show that the human stays in control.
beats.narration: The critic reviews the manifest, suggests safe changes, and waits for approval.
